international.source: World Bank Commodity Price Data (Pink Sheet), Coffee Arabica, USD/kg, monthly

farmgate_observed.source: FAOSTAT Producer Prices, Peru, Coffee green (tracks MIDAGRI pergamino farmgate price)

pass_through.description: Peru farmgate (FAOSTAT USD/t) divided by Pink Sheet Arabica annual average. Empirical, computed for this tool.

fx.source: Implied by FAOSTAT 2024 (10,850 PEN/t / 2,888 USD/t). Refreshed from open.er-api.com when online.

units.note: Pergamino is often sold per 46 kg quintal or 56-60 kg sacks; humidity changes the real weight.

disclaimer: Reference band, not a guaranteed price. Quality (cup score, humidity, yield factor) moves the real price. Ask your cooperative or the Junta Nacional del Cafe.
